text: In Kripke semantics, ◇φ is true at a world w if and only if there exists at least one world v accessible from w at which φ is true.
explanation: True: this is exactly the satisfaction clause for possibility, M,w ⊨ ◇φ iff ∃v (wRv and M,v ⊨ φ). It is the existential dual of □φ, whose clause quantifies universally over all accessible worlds.
